alex: Draft snippet (batch auth + call) below:
```
# v1
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['OLD_KEY'])
res = client.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', prompt=p, batch_size=8)

# v2
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])
res = c.text.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', inputs=[p1,p2], max_tokens=128)
```
jia: KV samples:
JS: `await prefetch.load(keys, {limit:64})`
Python:
```py
async def prefetch(keys, limit=64):
    await client.kv.prefetch(keys[:limit])
```
